summary: GRI 14 gives organizations involved in mining activities information on their likely material topics, based on the sector's most significant impacts on the economy, environment and people. It lists the disclosures to report for each topic, from tailings and closure to community rights and payments.

questions.text: Closure and rehabilitation of sites: for each mine site, does it have a closure and rehabilitation plan, is it undergoing closure and rehabilitation, or has it been closed and rehabilitated?

questions.text: Estimated life of mine: what is the estimated life of mine for each mine site?
questions.hint: For each mine site, the estimated life of the mine (LOM).

questions.text: Financial provisions for closure and rehabilitation: what are the total estimated closure costs, the methodology, and the financial instruments used to guarantee provisions?
questions.hint: a. Total estimated closure cost (not discounted), whether provision covers full amount and meets regulatory requirements, by mine site; b. methodology for estimating the cost; c. financial instruments used to guarantee adequate provisions.
